enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +20: Passive: +20 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Sonic Blast 4: This weapon rings with the power of sound, dealing 4d6 Sonic damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Sonic damage on a critical hit.
Devotion +111: Passive: +111 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Resonance +111: Passive: +111 Equipment bonus to Sonic Spell Power.
